title: The Sweet Promise
author: Paloma Nakamura
blurb: Hazel Yarrow, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
